source.text: יְהוָ֣ה מָ֭לָךְ יִרְגְּז֣וּ עַמִּ֑ים יֹשֵׁ֥ב כְּ֝רוּבִ֗ים תָּנ֥וּט הָאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: YHWH reigns; let [the] peoples tremble; [he is] sitting [on the] cherubim; let the earth quake.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} reigns; let the peoples tremble! \q [He is] enthroned [on the] cherubim; let the earth quake!
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is King; let the peoples shudder! \q He is seated on the cherubim as on a throne; let the earth shake!
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is King! The nations should tremble. \q He sits on {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} throne above the winged cherubim. The whole earth should shake!

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} règne ; que les peuples tremblent ! \q [Il est] assis [sur les] chérubins ; que la terre chancelle !
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est roi ; que les peuples frémissent ! \q Il siège sur les chérubins comme sur un trône ; que la terre vacille !
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est roi ! Les nations devraient trembler. \q Il est assis sur {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} trône au-dessus des chérubins ailés. Toute la terre devrait trembler !

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anatawala; mataifa na yatetemeke! \q [Ameketi juu ya] makerubi; nchi na itikisike!
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni Mfalme; mataifa na yatetemeke! \q Ameketi juu ya makerubi kama juu ya kiti cha enzi; nchi na itikisike!
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni Mfalme! Mataifa yanapaswa kutetemeka. \q Ameketi katika kiti {{deity_pronoun:chake|Chake}} cha enzi juu ya makerubi wenye mabawa. Dunia yote inapaswa kutikisika!

decisions.choice: reigns: is King, has taken the throne
decisions.reason: The verb (malak) with the LORD as subject is the cry of Psalms 93, 96, 97 and 99. The same form was shouted when a new king took the throne (2 Samuel 15:10; 2 Kings 9:13), so it may also mean "has become King": the LORD is acclaimed as King over all the earth.

decisions.choice: enthroned on the cherubim: above the ark
decisions.reason: The cherubim were two winged figures of gold on the cover of the ark of the covenant. The LORD was pictured as seated above them, as on a throne, and spoke from there (Exodus 25:18-22; 1 Samuel 4:4; 80:2).
The psalm is built around the cry "holy is he" (verses 3, 5, 9), as in Isaiah 6:3.
Balanced and Readable say "is King", the plain sense of the royal cry; Literal keeps "reigns".
Readable says what sitting on the cherubim means (m2).

source.text: יְ֭הוָה בְּצִיּ֣וֹן גָּד֑וֹל וְרָ֥ם ה֝֗וּא עַל־כָּל־הָֽעַמִּֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: YHWH in Zion [is] great, and exalted [is] he over all the peoples.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} in Zion [is] great, \q and exalted [is] {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} over all the peoples.
en.B: In Zion {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is great; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} towers over all the peoples.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is great in Jerusalem. \q He rules high above all the nations.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} en Sion [est] grand, \q et élevé [est-]{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} au-dessus de tous les peuples.
fr.B: En Sion, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est grand ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} domine tous les peuples.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est grand à Jérusalem. \q Il règne bien au-dessus de toutes les nations.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} katika Sayuni [ni] mkuu, \q {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} ametukuka juu ya mataifa yote.
sw.B: Katika Sayuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mkuu; \q {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} yuko juu sana ya mataifa yote.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mkuu katika Yerusalemu. \q Anatawala juu sana ya mataifa yote.

decisions.choice: Zion: the hill of the temple
decisions.reason: Zion is the hill in Jerusalem where the temple and the ark stood, the place of the LORD's throne on earth (verse 1).
The word (ram) means high; the King in Zion is high above all nations.
Readable names the city.

source.text: יוֹד֣וּ שִׁ֭מְךָ גָּד֥וֹל וְנוֹרָ֗א קָד֥וֹשׁ הֽוּא׃

records.literal_gloss: Let them give thanks to your name, great and to be feared; holy [is] he.

en.L: Let them give thanks to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name, great and to be feared. \q Holy [is] {{deity_pronoun:he|He}}!
en.B: Let the peoples give thanks to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name, great and awe-inspiring. \q He is holy!
en.R: Let the nations praise {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are great and fill people with awe. \q He is holy!

fr.L: Qu’ils rendent grâce à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom, grand et redoutable. \q Saint [est-]{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} !
fr.B: Que les peuples rendent grâce à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom, grand et redoutable. \q Il est saint !
fr.R: Que les nations {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} louent, car {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es grand et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} remplis les gens de crainte. \q Il est saint !

sw.L: Na walishukuru jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}, kuu na la kuogopwa. \q Yeye [ni] mtakatifu!
sw.B: Mataifa na yalishukuru jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}, kuu na la kutisha. \q Yeye ni mtakatifu!
sw.R: Mataifa na yakusifu, kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ni mkuu na unawajaza watu hofu takatifu. \q Yeye ni mtakatifu!

decisions.choice: your name ... holy is he: a change of person
decisions.reason: The psalm speaks to God ("your name") and then about him ("holy is he"), a shift common in the psalms. The refrain "holy is he" is addressed to the hearers.
God's holiness is his utter difference from everything he made, and his purity. The refrain answers the song of the seraphim, "Holy, holy, holy" (Isaiah 6:3).
"Them" are the peoples of verse 2.
Readable says "you" for "your name", which stands for God himself.

source.text: וְעֹ֥ז מֶלֶךְ֮ מִשְׁפָּ֪ט אָ֫הֵ֥ב אַ֭תָּה כּוֹנַ֣נְתָּ מֵישָׁרִ֑ים מִשְׁפָּ֥ט וּ֝צְדָקָ֗ה בְּיַעֲקֹ֤ב׀אַתָּ֬ה עָשִֽׂיתָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] strength of [the] king loves justice. You, you have established uprightness; justice and righteousness in Jacob you, you have done.

en.L: And the strength of the King loves justice. \q You have established uprightness; \q justice and righteousness in Jacob {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have done.
en.B: Mighty King who loves justice, \q it is {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} who have set fairness firmly in place; \q {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have done what is just and right in Jacob.
en.R: Mighty King, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} love justice. \q You have made fairness firm and sure. \q Among Jacob's people, Israel, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have done what is right and fair.

fr.L: Et la force du Roi aime le droit. \q C’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} qui as établi la droiture ; \q le droit et la justice en Jacob, c’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} qui [les] as faits.
fr.B: Roi puissant qui aimes le droit, \q c’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} qui as fermement établi l’équité ; \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fait en Jacob ce qui est juste et droit.
fr.R: Roi puissant, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} aimes la justice. \q Tu as rendu l’équité solide et sûre. \q Chez le peuple de Jacob, Israël, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fait ce qui est juste et équitable.

sw.L: Na nguvu ya Mfalme inapenda hukumu. \q Wewe umethibitisha unyofu; \q hukumu na haki katika Yakobo {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} umezitenda.
sw.B: Ee Mfalme mwenye nguvu unayependa haki, \q ni {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} uliyeuweka usawa imara; \q umetenda yaliyo ya haki na ya kweli katika Yakobo.
sw.R: Ee Mfalme mwenye nguvu, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unapenda haki. \q Umeufanya usawa kuwa imara na thabiti. \q Kati ya watu wa Yakobo, yaani Israeli, umetenda yaliyo ya haki na ya usawa.

decisions.choice: the strength of the King loves justice: the mighty King loves justice
alternatives: the King is mighty, he loves justice
decisions.reason: The words are hard to join. Literally "the strength of a king loves justice", they may mean that the King's might is put to work for justice, or be an address, "Mighty King, lover of justice". Balanced and Readable take it as an address leading into "you have established".

decisions.choice: you, you: it is you who did it
decisions.reason: The Hebrew adds the pronoun "you" twice for emphasis: it is God himself who established justice.
Jacob, renamed Israel, stands for the nation descended from him.
Readable says who Jacob stands for (m3).

source.text: רֽוֹמְמ֡וּ יְה֘וָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ וְֽ֭הִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לַהֲדֹ֥ם רַגְלָ֗יו קָד֥וֹשׁ הֽוּא׃

records.literal_gloss: Exalt YHWH our God and bow down at [the] footstool of his feet; holy [is] he.

en.L: Exalt {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God, \q and bow down at the footstool of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} feet. \q Holy [is] {{deity_pronoun:he|He}}!
en.B: Lift high {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God, \q and bow low at {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} footstool. \q He is holy!
en.R: Honor {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God as high above all! \q Bow down at {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} temple, the footstool where {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} rests {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} feet. \q He is holy!

fr.L: Exaltez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu, \q et prosternez-vous devant le marchepied de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} pieds. \q Saint [est-]{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} !
fr.B: Élevez bien haut {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu, \q et inclinez-vous devant {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} marchepied. \q Il est saint !
fr.R: Honorez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu, car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est au-dessus de tout ! \q Inclinez-vous devant {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} temple, le marchepied où {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} pose {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} pieds. \q Il est saint !

sw.L: Mtukuzeni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu, \q na msujudu penye kiti cha miguu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. \q Yeye [ni] mtakatifu!
sw.B: Mwinueni juu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu, \q msujudu mbele ya kiti {{deity_pronoun:chake|Chake}} cha miguu. \q Yeye ni mtakatifu!
sw.R: Mheshimuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu kama aliye juu ya yote! \q Sujuduni katika hekalu {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}, kiti anachowekea miguu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. \q Yeye ni mtakatifu!

decisions.choice: the footstool of his feet: the ark, the temple
decisions.reason: The ark of the covenant was called God's footstool (1 Chronicles 28:2), and so was the temple where it stood (132:7; Lamentations 2:1). The King sits enthroned in heaven; his feet rest on earth.

decisions.choice: exalt: lift high, honor as highest
decisions.reason: The verb (romem) is to raise up, that is, to praise God as the highest.
Readable names the place the footstool stands for (m1).

source.text: מֹ֘שֶׁ֤ה וְאַהֲרֹ֨ן׀בְּֽכֹהֲנָ֗יו וּ֭שְׁמוּאֵל בְּקֹרְאֵ֣י שְׁמ֑וֹ קֹרִ֥אים אֶל־יְ֝הוָ֗ה וְה֣וּא יַעֲנֵֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Moses and Aaron [were] among his priests, and Samuel among those who called on his name; [they were] calling to YHWH, and he answered them.

en.L: Moses and Aaron [were] among {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} priests, \q and Samuel among those who called on {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name; \q [they were] calling to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} answered them.
en.B: Among {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} priests were Moses and Aaron, \q and among those who called on {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name was Samuel; \q they called out to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} answered them.
en.R: Moses and Aaron served as {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} priests. \q Samuel also prayed to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \q They called out to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for help, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} answered them.

fr.L: Moïse et Aaron [étaient] parmi {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} prêtres, \q et Samuel parmi ceux qui invoquaient {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom ; \q [ils] criaient {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur répondait.
fr.B: Parmi {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} prêtres il y avait Moïse et Aaron, \q et parmi ceux qui invoquaient {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom, Samuel ; \q ils criaient vers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur répondait.
fr.R: Moïse et Aaron étaient {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} prêtres. \q Samuel aussi {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} priait. \q Ils appelaient {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} à l’aide, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur répondait.

sw.L: Musa na Haruni [walikuwa] kati ya makuhani {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, \q na Samweli kati ya wale walioliitia jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}; \q [walikuwa] wakimwita {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} akawajibu.
sw.B: Kati ya makuhani {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} walikuwa Musa na Haruni, \q na kati ya wale walioliitia jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} alikuwa Samweli; \q walimlilia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} akawajibu.
sw.R: Musa na Haruni walimtumikia kama makuhani {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. \q Samweli naye alimwomba. \q Walimlilia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} awasaidie, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} akawajibu.

decisions.reason: Moses was a Levite and did a priest's work when he set Aaron apart and offered the sacrifices of the covenant (Exodus 24:6-8; Leviticus 8).

decisions.choice: call on his name: pray to God, worship him
decisions.reason: To call on God's name is to pray and worship. Moses and Samuel were remembered as the great ones who prayed for the people (Jeremiah 15:1; 1 Samuel 7:9; 12:18).
Readable says why they called.

source.text: בְּעַמּ֣וּד עָ֭נָן יְדַבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵיהֶ֑ם שָׁמְר֥וּ עֵ֝דֹתָ֗יו וְחֹ֣ק נָֽתַן־לָֽמוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: In [a] pillar of cloud he spoke to them; they kept his testimonies and [the] statute [that] he gave to them.

en.L: In the pillar of cloud {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} spoke to them; \q they kept {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} testimonies and the statute [that] {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gave to them.
en.B: From the pillar of cloud {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} spoke with them; \q they kept the decrees {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} laid down and the rule {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gave them.
en.R: He spoke to them from the tall column of cloud. \q They obeyed {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} laws and the rules {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gave them.

fr.L: Dans la colonne de nuée {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur parlait ; \q ils gardaient {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} témoignages et la prescription [qu’]{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur avait donnée.
fr.B: De la colonne de nuée, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur parlait ; \q ils gardaient les décrets qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait établis et la loi qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur avait donnée.
fr.R: Il leur parlait depuis la haute colonne de nuée. \q Ils obéissaient à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} lois et aux règles qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur avait données.

sw.L: Katika nguzo ya wingu alisema nao; \q walizishika shuhuda {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} na kanuni aliyowapa.
sw.B: Kutoka katika nguzo ya wingu alizungumza nao; \q walishika maagizo aliyoyaweka na kanuni aliyowapa.
sw.R: Alizungumza nao kutoka katika nguzo ndefu ya wingu. \q Walitii sheria {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} na kanuni alizowapa.

decisions.reason: God spoke to Moses and Aaron from the pillar of cloud at the tent of meeting (Exodus 33:9; Numbers 12:5). Samuel did not live in the desert, so "them" looks first to Moses and Aaron, with Samuel as one of their line.

decisions.choice: testimonies, statute: the terms of the covenant
decisions.reason: The testimonies ('edot) are God's solemn terms, witnessed in the covenant (19:8); the statute (choq) is a fixed rule.
Readable describes the pillar in plain words.

source.text: יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵינוּ֮ אַתָּ֪ה עֲנִ֫יתָ֥ם אֵ֣ל נֹ֭שֵׂא הָיִ֣יתָ לָהֶ֑ם וְ֝נֹקֵ֗ם עַל־עֲלִילוֹתָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: YHWH our God, you, you answered them; a forgiving God you were to them, and avenging on their deeds.

en.L: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} our God, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} answered them; \q a forgiving God {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} were to them, \q and [an] avenger of their deeds.
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} our God, it was {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} who answered them. \q To them {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} were a God who forgives, \q yet one who punished their wrongs.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} our God, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} answered their prayers. \q You forgave them, \q but {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} also punished them when they did wrong.

fr.L: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} leur as répondu ; \q un Dieu qui pardonne, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} l’as été pour eux, \q et [un] vengeur de leurs actes.
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu, c’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} qui leur as répondu. \q Pour eux {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as été un Dieu qui pardonne, \q mais qui punissait aussi leurs fautes.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as répondu à leurs prières. \q Tu leur as pardonné, \q mais {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} les as aussi punis quand ils faisaient le mal.

sw.L: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} uliwajibu; \q Mungu mwenye kusamehe ulikuwa kwao, \q na mlipiza kisasi kwa matendo yao.
sw.B: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu, ni {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} uliyewajibu. \q Kwao ulikuwa Mungu anayesamehe, \q lakini pia uliyeadhibu makosa yao.
sw.R: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu, ulijibu maombi yao. \q Uliwasamehe, \q lakini pia uliwaadhibu walipotenda mabaya.

decisions.reason: The word (nose') is "lifting, carrying"; with sin it means taking it away, forgiving (Exodus 34:7).

decisions.choice: avenging on their deeds: punishing their wrongs
decisions.reason: God forgave, yet did not leave wrong unpunished: Moses and Aaron themselves were kept from the land (Numbers 20:12). The words could also mean that God avenged the wrongs others did to them, but "their deeds" most likely means their own.

source.text: רֽוֹמְמ֡וּ יְה֘וָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ וְ֭הִֽשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְהַ֣ר קָדְשׁ֑וֹ כִּֽי־קָ֝ד֗וֹשׁ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Exalt YHWH our God and bow down at [the] mountain of his holiness, for holy [is] YHWH our God.

en.L: Exalt {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God, \q and bow down at the mountain of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holiness, \q for holy [is] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God.
en.B: Lift high {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God, \q and bow low on {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy hill, \q because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God is holy.
en.R: Honor {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God as high above all! \q Worship {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} on {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy mountain in Jerusalem, \q because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God is holy!

fr.L: Exaltez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu, \q et prosternez-vous vers la montagne de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} sainteté, \q car saint [est] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu.
fr.B: Élevez bien haut {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu, \q et inclinez-vous sur {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} sainte colline, \q car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu est saint.
fr.R: Honorez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu, car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est au-dessus de tout ! \q Adorez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} sur {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} sainte montagne, à Jérusalem, \q car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu est saint !

sw.L: Mtukuzeni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu, \q na msujudu katika mlima wa utakatifu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, \q kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu [ni] mtakatifu.
sw.B: Mwinueni juu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu, \q msujudu juu ya mlima {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mtakatifu, \q kwa sababu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu ni mtakatifu.
sw.R: Mheshimuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu kama aliye juu ya yote! \q Mwabuduni juu ya mlima {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mtakatifu huko Yerusalemu, \q kwa sababu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu ni mtakatifu!

decisions.reason: The holy mountain is Zion, the temple hill (2:6; 3:5; 99:2).
The refrain of verses 3 and 5, "holy is he", returns as "holy is the LORD our God", closing the psalm.
Readable says where the holy mountain is.
